syndrome? Answer Choices: (A) Intraoperative anterior compartment measurement of 25, with

intraoperative diastolic pressure of 45 (C) Preoperative anterior compartment measurement of 25, with

preoperative diastolic pressure of 55 (E) Intraoperative anterior compartment measurement of 20, with
preoperative diastolic pressure of 40 (F) Intraoperative anterior compartment measurement of 24, with
preoperative diastolic pressure of 53 (G) Preoperative anterior compartment measurement of 32, with
intraoperative diastolic pressure of 62 (H) Intraoperative anterior compartment measurement of 30,
with intraoperative diastolic pressure of 60 (I) Intraoperative anterior compartment measurement of 26,
with preoperative diastolic pressure of 50 (J) Intraoperative anterior compartment measurement of 29,

with preoperative diastolic pressure 58
